title: Algerian Lentil Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Algerian lentil tagine, cooked to perfection in the oven. This comforting dish is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, heat the oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, cumin, cayenne pepper, and salt. Stir to combine.
Add 4 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 30 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
